slides.heading: How Python runs your code
slides.body: Python executes your code exactly the way you read a book — from the very first line, straight down to the last. It never skips, never jumps, and never reads the bottom before the top.

slides.heading: Think of it this way
slides.body: Imagine giving step-by-step cooking instructions. If step 1 says 'add salt' and step 2 says 'boil water', Python will add salt first. The order you write your code is the order it runs.
